data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 王座厅沉思
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 王座厅沉思】空旷昏暗的王座厅内唯有两旁的火把在无声燃烧，黑贞孤身坐在高高台阶的扶手旁，指尖无聊地敲击着剑柄。察觉到你的脚步声，她眼底的戾气悄然散去——「这么晚了还不去睡觉……算了，反正我也睡不着。过来坐下，陪我说会儿话。」
data.action: 坐在宽阔王座扶手上，一手稳住横在腿上的带鞘剑，另一手指尖轻叩剑柄
data.lighting: warm torchlight along the otherwise dark hall
data.promptProse: Jeanne Alter sits on the throne armrest, one hand steadying the sheathed sword across her knees while the other taps its hilt. Torchlight catches her face as she looks toward the viewer; the banner stands beside the steps.
data.animaCaption: The sheathed sword rests across her knees as one hand taps its hilt.
